# Server test classes CI's server job leaves out (build-and-test.yml, "Test server"). One per line:
#   UT_Name  # why it can't run in CI (#issue)
# Every class here reads the installed game files (navmeshes, the played or release database, captured route logs), which
# are never in Git, and is also [Explicit], so it runs only when named. The ones that need only the navmeshes, or the
# navmeshes and a clean world, and assert something also run in the navmesh job, from the published navmesh set and its
# clean world (.github/navmesh-tests.txt, #684, #687); they stay listed here because the server job has neither. The
# rest run on the owner's PC. Issue #619 tracks the list: an
# entry comes off when its class no longer needs installed files. A synthetic test never goes here; fix it, or quarantine
# it as UT_Name.Method with its own issue (docs/CI.md, "Excluded tests"). source/tools/ci_test_results.py checks the format.
# Run them on a PC with a playable folder: python source/tools/run_installed_tests.py --game <folder> (--list shows each
# class's variables; the tests get a copy of the world, never the world itself).
UT_AllFrontierKeepRoutes  # installed frontier route simulation; read only: needs the world database beside the navmeshes (../data or OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH); runs in the navmesh job from the set's clean world (.github/navmesh-tests.txt), [Explicit] (#619, #684, #687)
UT_AnimistInstalledCatalog  # needs the world database only (no navmesh); runs in the navmesh job from the set's clean world (.github/navmesh-tests.txt), [Explicit] (#619, #684, #687)
UT_AuditHotspotProbe  # read-only installed-navmesh hotspot probe: needs the world database beside the navmeshes (../data or OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH); fails on the fresh install's set, so not in the navmesh job yet, [Explicit] (#619, #684, #704)
UT_AuditedDungeonInstalledMesh  # read-only installed dungeon coverage audit: needs the world database beside the navmeshes (../data or OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH); runs in the navmesh job from the set's clean world (.github/navmesh-tests.txt), [Explicit] (#619, #684, #687)
UT_CrauchonResponseRoutes  # read-only installed Crauchon response incident: needs the world database beside the navmeshes (../data or OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH); fails on the fresh install's set, so not in the navmesh job yet, [Explicit] (#619, #684, #704)
UT_CurrentDungeonGoalRoutes  # read-only installed native routes for every current ordinary dungeon goal: needs the world database beside the navmeshes (../data or OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH); runs in the navmesh job from the set's clean world (.github/navmesh-tests.txt), [Explicit] (#619, #684, #687)
UT_DragonLairProbe  # navmesh only: runs in the navmesh job from the published set (.github/navmesh-tests.txt), [Explicit] (#619, #684)
UT_DungeonProofGenerator  # generates navigation proofs from the installed navmesh: needs the world database beside the navmeshes (../data or OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH), [Explicit] (#619, #684)
UT_ExchangePlacementNavigation  # navmesh only; InspectCapitalFloors runs in the navmesh job, ValidatePlannedPositionsAndApproaches needs a placement plan file (OFFLINE_DAOC_EXCHANGE_PLAN), [Explicit] (#619, #684)
UT_ExpeditionHubFailures  # read-only reproduction of captured expedition routes: needs the world database beside the navmeshes (../data or OFFLINE_DAOC_DB_PATH); fails on the fresh install's set, so not in the navmesh job yet, [Explicit] (#619, #684, #704)
